aidyourally.name: Aid Your Ally
aidyourally.trigger: When you act in direct support of an ally...

text.p: When you act in direct support of an ally, envision how you aid them. Then, Secure an Advantage or Gain Ground to take action. If you score a hit, they (instead of you) take the benefits of the move.
If you Gain Ground and score a strong hit, you are both in control. On a weak hit, your ally is in control but you are in a bad spot.

checkyourgear.name: Check Your Gear
checkyourgear.trigger: When you check to see if you have a specific helpful item or resource...

text.p: When you check to see if you have a specific helpful item or resource, roll +supply.
On a strong hit, you have it, and are ready to act. Take +1 momentum.
On a weak hit, you have it, but must choose one.

list.li: Your supply is diminished: Sacrifice Resources (-1)
It's not quite right, and causes a complication or delay: Lose Momentum (-2)

text.p: On a miss, you don't have it and the situation grows more perilous. Pay the Price.

checkyourgear.strong: On a **strong hit**, you have it, and are ready to act. Take +1 momentum.
checkyourgear.weak: On a **weak hit**, you have it, but must choose one. - Your supply is diminished: Sacrifice Resources (-1) - It's not quite right, and causes a complication or delay: Lose Momentum (-2)
checkyourgear.miss: On a **miss**, you don't have it and the situation grows more perilous. Pay the Price.

compel.name: Compel
compel.trigger: When you try to persuade someone or make them an offer...

text.p: When you try to persuade someone or make them an offer, envision your approach. If you...

list.li: Charm, pacify, encourage, or barter: Roll +heart
Threaten or incite: Roll +iron
Lie or swindle: Roll +shadow

text.p: On a strong hit, they'll do what you want or agree to your conditions. Take +1 momentum.
On a weak hit, as above, but their agreement comes with a demand or complication. Envision their counteroffer.
On a miss, they refuse or make a demand that costs you greatly. Pay the Price.

compel.weak: On a **weak hit**, they'll do what you want or agree to your conditions, but their agreement comes with a demand or complication. Envision their counteroffer and take +1 momentum.
compel.miss: On a **miss**, they refuse or make a demand that costs you greatly. Pay the Price.

facedanger.name: Face Danger
facedanger.trigger: When you attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat...

text.p: When you attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat, envision your action and roll. If you act...

list.li: With speed, mobility, or agility: Roll +edge
With resolve, command, or sociability: Roll +heart
With strength, endurance, or aggression: Roll +iron
With deception, stealth, or trickery: Roll +shadow
With expertise, focus, or observation: Roll +wits

text.p: On a strong hit, you are successful. Take +1 momentum.
On a weak hit, you succeed, but not without a cost. Make a suffer move (-1).
On a miss, you fail, or a momentary success is undermined by a dire turn of events. Pay the Price.

gatherinformation.name: Gather Information
gatherinformation.trigger: When you search for clues, conduct an investigation, analyze evidence, or do research...

text.p: When you search for clues, conduct an investigation, analyze evidence, or do research, roll +wits.
On a strong hit, you discover something helpful and specific. The path you must follow or action you must take to make progress is made clear. Envision what you learn. Then, take +2 momentum.
On a weak hit, the information provides new insight, but also complicates your quest. Envision what you discover. Then, take +1 momentum.
On a miss, your investigation unearths a dire threat or reveals an unwelcome truth that undermines your quest. Pay the Price.

gatherinformation.strong: On a **strong hit**, you discover something helpful and specific. The path you must follow or action you must take to make progress is made clear. Envision what you learn. Then, take +2 momentum.
gatherinformation.weak: On a **weak hit**, the information provides new insight, but also complicates your quest. Envision what you discover. Then, take +1 momentum.
gatherinformation.miss: On a **miss**, your investigation unearths a dire threat or reveals an unwelcome truth that undermines your quest. Pay the Price.

secureanadvantage.name: Secure an Advantage
secureanadvantage.trigger: When you assess a situation, make preparations, or attempt to gain leverage...

text.p: When you assess a situation, make preparations, or attempt to gain leverage, envision your action and roll. If you act...

list.li: With speed, mobility, or agility: Roll +edge
With resolve, command, or sociability: Roll +heart
With strength, endurance, aggression: Roll +iron
With deception, stealth, or trickery: Roll +shadow
With expertise, focus, or observation: Roll +wits

text.p: On a hit, you succeed. On a strong hit, take both. On a weak hit, choose one.

list.li: Take +2 momentum
Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)

text.p: On a miss, you fail or your assumptions betray you. Pay the Price.

secureanadvantage.strong: On a **strong hit**, you succeed. Take +2 momentum. Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move).
secureanadvantage.weak: On a **weak hit**, you succeed. Choose one. - Take +2 momentum - Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)
secureanadvantage.miss: On a **miss**, you fail or your assumptions betray you. Pay the Price.

battle.name: Battle
battle.trigger: When you fight a battle and it happens in a blur...

text.p: When you fight a battle and it happens in a blur, envision your objective and roll. If you primarily...

list.li: Fight at range, or using your speed and the environment to your advantage: Roll +edge.
Fight depending on your courage, leadership, or companions: Roll +heart.
Fight in close to overpower your foe: Roll +iron.
Fight using trickery to befuddle your foe: Roll +shadow.
Fight using careful tactics to outsmart your foe: Roll +wits.

text.p: On a strong hit, you achieve your objective unconditionally. You and any allies who joined the battle may take +2 momentum.
On a weak hit, you achieve your objective, but not without cost. Pay the Price.
On a miss, you are defeated or the objective is lost. Pay the Price.

clash.name: Clash
clash.trigger: When you are in a bad spot and fight back against a foe at close quarters, or when you exchange fire at a distance...

text.p: When you are in a bad spot and fight back against a foe at close quarters, roll +iron; when you exchange fire at a distance, roll +edge.
On a strong hit, mark progress twice. You overwhelm your foe and are in control.
On a weak hit, mark progress, but you are dealt a counterblow or setback. You stay in a bad spot and must Pay the Price.
On a miss, your foe dominates this exchange. You stay in a bad spot and must Pay the Price.

enterthefray.name: Enter the Fray
enterthefray.trigger: When you initiate combat or are forced into a fight...

text.p: When you initiate combat or are forced into a fight, envision your objective and give it a rank. If the combat includes discrete challenges or phases, set an objective with a rank for each.
Then, roll to see if you are in control. If you are...

list.li: On the move: Roll +edge
Facing off against your foe: Roll +heart
In the thick of it at close quarters: Roll +iron
Preparing to act against an unaware foe: Roll +shadow
Caught in a trap or sizing up the situation: Roll +wits

text.p: On a strong hit, take both. On a weak hit, choose one.

list.li: Take +2 momentum
You are in control

text.p: On a miss, the fight begins with you in a bad spot.

facedefeat.trigger: When you abandon or are deprived of an objective...

text.p: When you abandon or are deprived of an objective, envision the consequence of this failure, clear the objective, and Pay the Price.
If the fight continues, you may create a new objective and give it a rank to represent the changing situation. If any objectives remain, the fight continues and you are in a bad spot.

gainground.name: Gain Ground
gainground.trigger: When you are in control and take action in a fight to reinforce your position or move toward an objective...

text.p: When you are in control and take action in a fight to reinforce your position or move toward an objective, envision your approach and roll. If you are...

list.li: In pursuit, fleeing, or maneuvering: Roll +edge
Charging boldly into action, coming to the aid of others, negotiating, or commanding: Roll +heart
Gaining leverage with force, powering through, or making a threat: Roll +iron
Hiding, preparing an ambush, or misdirecting: Roll +shadow
Coordinating a plan, studying a situation, or cleverly gaining leverage: Roll +wits

text.p: On a hit, you stay in control. On a strong hit, choose two. On a weak hit, choose one.

list.li: Mark progress
Take +2 momentum
Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)

text.p: On a miss, your foe gains the upper hand, the fight moves to a new location, or you encounter a new peril. You are in a bad spot and must Pay the Price.

gainground.weak: On a **weak hit**, you stay in control. Choose one. - Mark progress - Take +2 momentum - Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)
gainground.miss: On a **miss**, your foe gains the upper hand, the fight moves to a new location, or you encounter a new peril. You are in a bad spot and must Pay the Price.

reactunderfire.name: React Under Fire
reactunderfire.trigger: When you are in a bad spot and take action in a fight to avoid danger or overcome an obstacle...

text.p: When you are in a bad spot and take action in a fight to avoid danger or overcome an obstacle, envision your approach and roll. If you are...

list.li: In pursuit, fleeing, dodging, getting back into position, or taking cover: Roll +edge
Remaining stalwart against fear or temptation: Roll +heart
Blocking or diverting with force, or taking the hit: Roll +iron
Moving into hiding or creating a distraction: Roll +shadow
Changing the plan, finding a way out, or cleverly bypassing an obstacle: Roll +wits

text.p: On a strong hit, you succeed and are in control. Take +1 momentum.
On a weak hit, you avoid the worst of the danger or overcome the obstacle, but not without a cost. Make a suffer move (-1). You stay in a bad spot.
On a miss, the situation worsens. You stay in a bad spot and must Pay the Price.

strike.name: Strike
strike.trigger: When you are in control and assault a foe at close quarters, or when you attack at a distance...

text.p: When you are in control and assault a foe at close quarters, roll +iron; when you attack at a distance, roll +edge.
On a strong hit, mark progress twice. You dominate your foe and stay in control.
On a weak hit, mark progress twice, but you expose yourself to danger. You are in a bad spot.
On a miss, the fight turns against you. You are in a bad spot and must Pay the Price.

takedecisiveaction.name: Take Decisive Action
takedecisiveaction.trigger: When you seize an objective in a fight...

text.p: When you seize an objective in a fight, envision how you take decisive action. Then, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress.
If you are in control, check the result as normal. If you are in a bad spot, count a strong hit without a match as a weak hit, and a weak hit as a miss.
On a strong hit, you prevail. Take +1 momentum. If any objectives remain and the fight continues, you are in control.
On a weak hit, you achieve your objective, but not without cost. Roll on the table below or choose one. If the fight continues, you are in a bad spot.
On a miss, you are defeated or your objective is lost. Pay the Price.

takedecisiveaction.strong: On a **strong hit**, you prevail. Take +1 momentum. If any objectives remain and the fight continues, you are in control.
takedecisiveaction.weak: On a **weak hit**, you achieve your objective, but not without cost. Roll on the table below or choose one. If the fight continues, you are in a bad spot.
takedecisiveaction.miss: On a **miss**, you are defeated or your objective is lost. Pay the Price.

developyourrelationship.name: Develop Your Relationship
developyourrelationship.trigger: When you reinforce your relationship with a connection...

text.p: When you reinforce your relationship with a connection by doing any of the following...

list.li: swearing a vow to undertake a perilous quest in their service
completing a quest to their benefit
leveraging their help in desperate circumstances
giving them something of worth
sharing a profound moment
standing with them against hardship
overcoming a test of your relationship

text.p: ...you may mark progress per the rank of the connection.

If you already share a bond with the connection, do not mark progress. Instead, roll +their rank to learn the impact on your legacy: troublesome=+1; dangerous=+2; formidable=+3; extreme=+4; epic=+5. On a strong hit, mark 2 ticks on your bonds legacy track. On a strong hit with a match, you may also envision how recent events bolstered your connection’s standing and raise their rank by one (if not already epic). On a weak hit, take +2 momentum. On a miss, take no lasting benefit.

On a **strong hit**, mark 2 ticks on your bonds legacy track.
On a **strong hit with a match**, you may also envision how recent events bolstered your connection’s standing and raise their rank by one (if not already epic).

text.p: When your relationship with a connection is ready to evolve, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress.

On a strong hit, you now share a bond. Mark a reward on your bonds legacy track per the connection's rank: troublesome=1 tick; dangerous=2 ticks; formidable=1 box; extreme=2 boxes; epic=3 boxes. Any allies who share this connection also mark the reward. Then, choose one.

list.li: Bolster their influence: When they aid you on a move closely associated with their role, add +2 instead of +1.

makeaconnection.trigger: When you search out a new relationship or give focus to an existing relationship (not an ally or companion)...

On a strong hit, you create a connection. Give them a role and rank. Whenever your connection aids you on a move closely associated with their role, add +1 and take +1 momentum on a hit.
On a weak hit, as above, but this connection comes with a complication or cost. Envision what they reveal or demand.
On a miss, you don't make a connection and the situation worsens. Pay the Price.

On a weak hit, Develop Your Relationship, but also envision a demand or complication as a fallout of this test.
On a miss, or if you have no interest in maintaining this relationship, choose one.

list.li: Lose the connection: Envision how this impacts you and Pay the Price.

Prove your loyalty: Envision what you offer or what they demand, and Swear an Iron Vow (formidable or greater) to see it done. Until you complete the quest, take no benefit for the connection. If you refuse or fail the quest, the connection is permanently undone.

text.p: When your exploration of a waypoint uncovers something dreadful, decide the number of aspects: one, two, or three. Roll that number of times or choose that number of aspects on the table below. Then, envision how the encounter begins.
For each result, when you first confront that aspect within the scope of the encounter, you and your allies may mark one tick on your discoveries legacy track.

exploreawaypoint.name: Explore a Waypoint

text.p: When you divert from an expedition to examine a notable location, roll +wits.
On a strong hit, choose one. On a strong hit with a match, you may instead Make a Discovery.

list.li: Find an opportunity: Envision a favorable insight, situation, resource, or encounter. Then, take +2 momentum.
Gain progress: Mark progress on your expedition, per its rank.

text.p: On a weak hit, you uncover something interesting, but it is bound up in a peril or reveals an ominous aspect of this place. Envision what you encounter. Then, take +1 momentum.
On a miss, you encounter an immediate hardship or threat, and must Pay the Price. On a miss with a match, you may instead Confront Chaos.

finishanexpedition.name: Finish an Expedition

On a weak hit, as above, but you face an unforeseen complication at the end of your expedition. Make the legacy reward one rank lower, and envision what you encounter.

list.li: Abandon the expedition: Envision the cost of this setback and Pay the Price.
Return to the expedition: Roll both challenge dice, take the lowest value, and clear that number of progress boxes. Then, raise the expedition's rank by one (if not already epic).

finishanexpedition.weak: On a **weak hit**, you reach your destination or complete your survey, but you face an unforeseen complication at the end of your expedition. setacourse.name: Set a Course

On a weak hit, you arrive, but face a cost or complication. Choose one.

list.li: Suffer costs en route: Make a suffer move (-2), or two suffer moves (-1).
Face a complication at the destination: Envision what you encounter.

text.p: On a miss, you are waylaid by a significant threat, and must Pay the Price. If you overcome this obstacle, you may push on safely to your destination.

setacourse.miss: On a **miss**, you are waylaid by a significant threat, and must Pay the Price. If you overcome this obstacle, you may push on safely to your destination.

undertakeanexpedition.name: Undertake an Expedition
undertakeanexpedition.trigger: When you trailblaze a route through perilous space, journey over hazardous terrain, or survey a mysterious site...

list.li: Move at speed: Roll +edge
Keep under the radar: Roll +shadow
Stay vigilant: Roll +wits

text.p: On a strong hit, you reach a waypoint. Envision the location and mark progress per the rank of the expedition.
On a weak hit, as above, but this progress costs you. Choose one.

list.li: Suffer costs en route: Make a suffer move (-2), or two suffer moves (-1).
Face a peril at the waypoint: Envision what you encounter.

undertakeanexpedition.miss: On a **miss**, you are waylaid by a crisis, or arrive at a waypoint to confront an immediate hardship or threat. Do not mark progress, and Pay the Price.

asktheoracle.name: Ask the Oracle

text.p: When you seek to resolve questions, reveal details, discover locations, determine how other characters respond, or trigger encounters or events, you may...

list.li: Draw a conclusion: Decide the answer based on the most interesting and obvious result.
Spark an idea: Use an oracle table or other random prompt.
Ask a yes/no question: Decide the odds of a yes, and roll on the table below to check the answer.
Pick two: Envision two options. Rate one as likely, and roll on the table below to see if it is true. If not, it is the other.

paytheprice.name: Pay the Price
paytheprice.trigger: When you suffer the outcome of an action...

text.p: When you suffer the outcome of an action, choose one.

list.li: Make the most obvious negative outcome happen.
Ask the Oracle for inspiration. Interpret the answer as a hardship or complication appropriate to the situation.
Roll on the table below. If the result doesn’t fit the situation, roll again.

advance.name: Advance
advance.trigger: When you develop your abilities, improve your resources, gain a reward, or boost your influence...

text.p: When you develop your abilities, improve your resources, gain a reward, or boost your influence, you may spend 3 experience to add a new asset, or 2 experience to upgrade an asset. Choose from the following categories as appropriate to your focus and opportunities.

list.li: Module: Upgrade your command vehicle
Support Vehicle: Acquire or improve a secondary vehicle
Path: Bolster your personal capabilities or follow a new calling
Companion: Gain or improve a trusted helper
Deed: Learn from your experiences or build a legacy

continuealegacy.name: Continue a Legacy
continuealegacy.trigger: When you retire from your life as Ironsworn, or succumb to death or desolation...

text.p: When you retire from your life as Ironsworn, or succumb to death or desolation, you may create a new character in your established setting. If you do, roll the challenge dice and compare to each of the former character's legacy tracks: quests, bonds, and discoveries (one roll per track).
For each strong hit, choose one from below, or one from the weak hit or miss options.

list.li: Follow their path: Take one path or companion asset from the former character (at no cost), including any marked abilities.
Share a connection: Take one connection from the former character, including any accrued progress or bond benefits.
Accept an inheritance: Take the former character's command vehicle and one module or support vehicle (at no cost), including any marked abilities.

text.p: For each weak hit, choose one from below, or one from the miss options.

list.li: See it through: Choose one of the former character's unfinished quests, and Swear an Iron Vow (with an automatic strong hit) to see it done. You may immediately mark up to half their earned progress (round down) on this quest.

Rebuild a connection: Name one of the former character's connections, and envision how time or circumstances have changed them in a dramatic way. When you Make a Connection with them, take an automatic strong hit and mark two ticks on your bonds legacy track.

Explore familiar ground: Name a location that was meaningful to the former character. When you first visit that place, envision how it has changed or is endangered. Then, mark two ticks on your discoveries legacy track.

text.p: For each miss, choose one.

list.li: Deal with the aftermath: Envision how one of your former character's foes has gained power or influence.
Switch loyalties: Envision how you begin in opposition to your former character's beliefs, goals, or allegiances.
Open Pandora's Box: Envision how an advancement or discovery has unleashed unexpectedly dire consequences.

continuealegacy.strong:
On a **strong hit**, choose one: - Follow their path: Take one path or companion asset from the former character (at no cost), including any marked abilities. - Share a connection: Take one connection from the former character, including any accrued progress or bond benefits. - Accept an inheritance: Take the former character's command vehicle and one module or support vehicle (at no cost), including any marked abilities.
Alternatively, you may choose a weak hit option: - See it through: Choose one of the former character's unfinished quests, and Swear an Iron Vow (with an automatic strong hit) to see it done. You may immediately mark up to half their earned progress (round down) on this quest. - Rebuild a connection: Name one of the former character's connections, and envision how time or circumstances have changed them in a dramatic way. When you Make a Connection with them, take an automatic strong hit and mark two ticks on your bonds legacy track. - Explore familiar ground: Name a location that was meaningful to the former character. When you first visit that place, envision how it has changed or is endangered. Then, mark two ticks on your discoveries legacy track.
Or a miss option: - Deal with the aftermath: Envision how one of your former character's foes has gained power or influence. - Switch loyalties: Envision how you begin in opposition to your former character's beliefs, goals, or allegiances. - Open Pandora's Box: Envision how an advancement or discovery has unleashed unexpectedly dire consequences.
continuealegacy.weak:
On a **weak hit**, choose one: - See it through: Choose one of the former character's unfinished quests, and Swear an Iron Vow (with an automatic strong hit) to see it done. You may immediately mark up to half their earned progress (round down) on this quest. - Rebuild a connection: Name one of the former character's connections, and envision how time or circumstances have changed them in a dramatic way. When you Make a Connection with them, take an automatic strong hit and mark two ticks on your bonds legacy track. - Explore familiar ground: Name a location that was meaningful to the former character. When you first visit that place, envision how it has changed or is endangered. Then, mark two ticks on your discoveries legacy track.
Alternatively, you may choose a miss option: - Deal with the aftermath: Envision how one of your former character's foes has gained power or influence. - Switch loyalties: Envision how you begin in opposition to your former character's beliefs, goals, or allegiances. - Open Pandora's Box: Envision how an advancement or discovery has unleashed unexpectedly dire consequences.
continuealegacy.miss: On a **miss**, choose one: - Deal with the aftermath: Envision how one of your former character's foes has gained power or influence. - Switch loyalties: Envision how you begin in opposition to your former character's beliefs, goals, or allegiances. - Open Pandora's Box: Envision how an advancement or discovery has unleashed unexpectedly dire consequences.

earnexperience.name: Earn Experience
earnexperience.trigger: When you fill a box (four ticks) on any legacy track...

text.p: When you fill a box (four ticks) on any legacy track, take 2 experience. This experience may be spent when you Advance.

Once you completely fill the tenth box on any legacy track, clear that track. You may start again marking progress on the cleared track, but earn experience at a reduced rate of 1 experience (instead of 2) for each filled progress box. If you make a progress roll against this track, resolve the outcome as if at 10 progress.

forsakeyourvow.name: Forsake Your Vow
forsakeyourvow.trigger: When you renounce your quest, betray your promise, or the goal is lost to you...

text.p: When you renounce your quest, betray your promise, or the goal is lost to you, clear the vow.
Then, envision the impact of this failure and choose one or more as appropriate to the nature of the vow. Any allies who shared this vow may also envision a cost.

list.li: You are demoralized or dispirited: Endure Stress.
A connection loses faith: Test Your Relationship when you next interact.
You must abandon a path or resource: Discard an asset.
Someone else pays a price: Envision how a person, being, or community bears the cost of the failure.
Someone else takes advantage: Envision how an enemy gains power.
Your reputation suffers: Envision how this failure marks you.

fulfillyourvow.name: Fulfill Your Vow
fulfillyourvow.trigger: When you reach the end of your quest...

text.p: When you reach the end of your quest, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress.

On a strong hit, your vow is fulfilled. Mark a reward on your quests legacy track per the vow's rank: troublesome=1 tick; dangerous=2 ticks; formidable=1 box; extreme=2 boxes; epic=3 boxes. Any allies who shared this vow also mark the reward.

On a weak hit, as above, but there is more to be done or you realize the truth of your quest. If you Swear an Iron Vow to set things right, take your full legacy reward. Otherwise, make the legacy reward one rank lower (none for a troublesome quest).
On a miss, your vow is undone through an unexpected complication or realization. Envision what happens and choose one.

list.li: Give up on the quest: Forsake Your Vow.
Recommit to the quest: Roll both challenge dice, take the lowest value, and clear that number of progress boxes. Then, raise the vow's rank by one (if not already epic).

fulfillyourvow.strong: On a **strong hit**, your vow is fulfilled. Mark a reward on your quests legacy track per the vow's rank: troublesome=1 tick; dangerous=2 ticks; formidable=1 box; extreme=2 boxes; epic=3 boxes. Any allies who shared this vow also mark the reward.
fulfillyourvow.weak: On a **weak hit**, your vow is fulfilled, but there is more to be done or you realize the truth of your quest. If you Swear an Iron Vow to set things right, take your full legacy reward per the vow's rank: troublesome=1 tick; dangerous=2 ticks; formidable=1 box; extreme=2 boxes; epic=3 boxes. Otherwise, make the reward one rank lower. Any allies who shared this vow also mark the reward.
fulfillyourvow.miss: On a **miss**, your vow is undone through an unexpected complication or realization. Envision what happens and choose one. - Give up on the quest: Forsake Your Vow. - Recommit to the quest: Roll both challenge dice, take the lowest value, and clear that number of progress boxes. Then, raise the vow's rank by one (if not already epic).

reachamilestone.name: Reach a Milestone
reachamilestone.trigger: When you make headway in your quest...

text.p: When you make headway in your quest by doing any of the following...

list.li: overcoming a critical obstacle
gaining meaningful insight
completing a perilous expedition
acquiring a crucial item or resource
earning vital support
defeating a notable foe

text.p: ...you may mark progress per the rank of the vow.

swearanironvow.name: Swear an Iron Vow
swearanironvow.trigger: When you swear upon iron to complete a quest...

text.p: When you swear upon iron to complete a quest, write your vow and give it a rank. Then, roll +heart. If you swear this vow to a connection, add +1; if you share a bond, add +2.
On a strong hit, you are emboldened and it is clear what you must do next. Take +2 momentum.
On a weak hit, you are determined but begin your quest with more questions than answers. Take +1 momentum, and envision what you do to find a path forward.
On a miss, you must overcome a significant obstacle before you begin your quest. Envision what stands in your way.

swearanironvow.strong: On a **strong hit**, you are emboldened and it is clear what you must do next. Take +2 momentum.
swearanironvow.weak: On a **weak hit**, you are determined but begin your quest with more questions than answers. Take +1 momentum, and envision what you do to find a path forward.
swearanironvow.miss: On a **miss**, you must overcome a significant obstacle before you begin your quest. Envision what stands in your way.

heal.name: Heal
heal.trigger: When you receive medical care or provide treatment...

text.p: When you receive medical care or provide treatment, envision the situation and roll. If you...

list.li: Receive treatment from someone (not an ally): Roll +iron
Mend your own wounds: Roll +iron or +wits, whichever is lower
Obtain treatment for a companion: Roll +heart
Provide care: Roll +wits

text.p: On a strong hit, the care is helpful. If you (or the ally under your care) are wounded, clear the impact and take or give +2 health. Otherwise, take or give +3 health.
On a weak hit, as above, but the recovery costs extra time or resources. Choose one: Lose Momentum (-2) or Sacrifice Resources (-2).
On a miss, the aid is ineffective and the situation worsens. Pay the Price.

heal.strong: On a **strong hit**, the care is helpful. If you (or the ally under your care) are wounded, clear the impact and take or give +2 health. Otherwise, take or give +3 health.
heal.weak:
On a **weak hit**, the care is helpful. If you (or the ally under your care) are wounded, clear the impact and take or give +2 health. Otherwise, take or give +3 health.
However, the recovery costs extra time or resources. Choose one: Lose Momentum (-2) or Sacrifice Resources (-2).
heal.miss: On a **miss**, the aid is ineffective and the situation worsens. Pay the Price.

hearten.name: Hearten
hearten.trigger: When you socialize, share intimacy, or find a moment of peace...

text.p: When you socialize, share intimacy, or find a moment of peace, roll +heart.

On a strong hit, you find companionship or comfort and your spirit is strengthened. If you are shaken, clear the impact and take +1 spirit. Otherwise, take +2 spirit. If you make this move as you Sojourn, take +1 more.
On a weak hit, as above, but this indulgence is fleeting. Envision an interruption, complication, or inner conflict. Then, Lose Momentum (-1).
On a miss, you take no comfort and the situation worsens. Pay the Price.

hearten.strong: On a **strong hit**, you find companionship or comfort and your spirit is strengthened. If you are shaken, clear the impact and take +1 spirit. Otherwise, take +2 spirit. If you make this move as you Sojourn, take +1 more.
hearten.weak:
On a **weak hit**, you find companionship or comfort and your spirit is strengthened. If you are shaken, clear the impact and take +1 spirit. Otherwise, take +2 spirit. If you make this move as you Sojourn, take +1 more.
However, this indulgence is fleeting. Envision an interruption, complication, or inner conflict. Then, Lose Momentum (-1).
hearten.miss: On a **miss**, you take no comfort and the situation worsens. Pay the Price.

repair.name: Repair
repair.trigger: When you make repairs to your vehicles, modules, mechanical companions, or other devices...

text.p: When you make repairs to your vehicles, modules, mechanical companions, or other devices, envision the situation and roll. If you...

list.li: Make your own repairs, or direct a companion to make repairs: Roll +wits
Obtain repairs from someone (not an ally): Roll +supply

text.p: On a hit, you gain repair points as appropriate to the situation, per the table below. Additionally, you may Sacrifice Resources and exchange each -1 of supply for 1 extra repair point (up to 3 points).
Situation | Strong Hit | Weak Hit --------------|------------|--------- At a facility | 5 points | 3 points In the field | 3 points | 1 points Under fire | 2 points | 0 points
Spend repair points as follows. Unused points are discarded.

list.li: Clear the battered impact on a vehicle: 2 points
Fix one broken module: 2 points
Take +1 integrity on a vehicle: 1 point
Take +1 health for a mechanical companion: 1 point
Repair any other device: 3 points
Repair any other device, but with a complication or malfunction: 2 points

text.p: On a miss, the repairs are not made and the situation worsens. Pay the Price.

repair.strong:
On a **strong hit**, you gain repair points as appropriate to the situation, per the table below.

Additionally, you may Sacrifice Resources and exchange each -1 of supply for 1 extra repair point (up to 3 points).
Spend repair points as follows. resupply.name: Resupply
resupply.trigger: When you attempt to bolster your readiness...

text.p: When you attempt to bolster your readiness, envision the opportunity and your approach. If you...

list.li: Barter or make an appeal: Roll +heart
Threaten or seize: Roll +iron
Steal or swindle: Roll +shadow
Scavenge or craft: Roll +wits

text.p: On a strong hit, choose one.

list.li: If you are unprepared, clear the impact and take +1 supply. Otherwise, take +2 supply.
If you are in need of a specific item or resource that can reasonably be obtained, you acquire it. Take +1 momentum.

text.p: On a weak hit, as above, but you must first deal with a cost, complication, or demand. Envision the nature of this obstacle.
On a miss, you encounter an unexpected peril. Pay the Price.

resupply.strong: On a **strong hit**, choose one. - If you are unprepared, clear the impact and take +1 supply. Otherwise, take +2 supply. - If you are in need of a specific item or resource that can reasonably be obtained, you acquire it. Take +1 momentum.
resupply.weak:
On a **weak hit**, you must first deal with a cost, complication, or demand. Envision the nature of this obstacle.
Then choose one. - If you are unprepared, clear the impact and take +1 supply. Otherwise, take +2 supply. - If you are in need of a specific item or resource that can reasonably be obtained, you acquire it. Take +1 momentum.
resupply.miss: On a **miss**, you encounter an unexpected peril. Pay the Price.

sojourn.name: Sojourn
sojourn.trigger: When you spend time recovering within a community...

text.p: When you spend time recovering within a community, roll +heart.

On a strong hit, this is a safe refuge. You and your allies may each choose two recover contents: Heal, Hearten, Repair, or Resupply. Instead of rolling, assume an automatic strong hit for each. An individual move can be taken more than once.
On a weak hit, as above, but time is short or resources are strained. You and your allies each make one recover move instead of two, with no more than three moves total among the group.
On a miss, choose one.

list.li: The community needs your help, or makes a costly demand in exchange for safe harbor. Envision what they ask of you. If you do it, or Swear an Iron Vow to see it done, resolve this move as a strong hit.
You find no relief, and the situation grows worse. Pay the Price.

sojourn.strong: On a **strong hit**, this is a safe refuge. You and your allies may each choose two recover contents: Heal, Hearten, Repair, or Resupply. Instead of rolling, assume an automatic strong hit for each. An individual move can be taken more than once.
sojourn.weak: On a **weak hit**, this is a safe refuge, but time is short or resources are strained. You and your allies may each make one recover move (with no more than three moves total among the group): Heal, Hearten, Repair, or Resupply. Instead of rolling, assume an automatic strong hit for each. An individual move can be taken more than once.
sojourn.miss: On a **miss**, choose one. - The community needs your help, or makes a costly demand in exchange for safe harbor. Envision what they ask of you. If you do it, or Swear an Iron Vow to see it done, resolve this move as a strong hit. - You find no relief, and the situation grows worse. Pay the Price.

beginthescene.name: Begin the Scene
beginthescene.trigger: When you face an extended or complex challenge...

text.p: When you face an extended or complex challenge, name your objective and choose a rank as appropriate to the situation.

list.li: You have a clear advantage: Troublesome
You are ready to act: Dangerous
You are unprepared or outmatched: Formidable

text.p: Then, activate a 4-segment tension clock and Face Danger or Secure an Advantage to take action.

facedangerscenechallenge.name: Face Danger (Scene Challenge)
facedangerscenechallenge.trigger: When you attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat within a scene challenge...

text.p: When you attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat within a scene challenge, envision your action and roll. If you act...

list.li: With speed, mobility, or agility: Roll +edge
With resolve, command, or sociability: Roll +heart
With strength, endurance, or aggression: Roll +iron
With deception, stealth, or trickery: Roll +shadow
With expertise, focus, or observation: Roll +wits

text.p: On a strong hit, you are successful and mark progress. On a strong hit with a match, mark progress twice.
On a weak hit, you are successful and mark progress, but also encounter a complication or setback. Envision what occurs and fill a clock segment.
On a miss, you fail, or a momentary success is undermined by a dramatic turn of events. Fill a clock segment and Pay the Price. On a miss with a match, fill two segments and Pay the Price.

facedangerscenechallenge.strong: On a **strong hit**, you are successful and mark progress. On a **strong hit with a match**, mark progress twice.
facedangerscenechallenge.weak: On a **weak hit**, you are successful and mark progress, but also encounter a complication or setback. Envision what occurs and fill a clock segment.
facedangerscenechallenge.miss: On a **miss**, you fail, or a momentary success is undermined by a dramatic turn of events. Fill a clock segment and Pay the Price. On a **miss with a match**, fill two segments and Pay the Price.

finishthescene.name: Finish the Scene
finishthescene.trigger: When the scene challenge tension clock or progress track is filled, or when events lead to the scene’s conclusion...

text.p: When the scene challenge tension clock or progress track is filled, or when events lead to the scene’s conclusion, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress.
On a strong hit, you achieve your objective unconditionally.
On a weak hit, you succeed, but not without cost. You must Pay the Price. Make this a minor cost relative to the scope of the scene.
On a miss, you fail or are undermined by a dire and costly turn of events. Pay the Price.

finishthescene.strong: On a **strong hit**, you achieve your objective unconditionally.
finishthescene.weak: On a **weak hit**, you succeed, but not without cost. You must Pay the Price. Make this a minor cost relative to the scope of the scene.
finishthescene.miss: On a **miss**, you fail, or are undermined by a dramatic and costly turn of events. Pay the Price. Make it hurt.

secureanadvantagescenechallenge.name: Secure an Advantage (Scene Challenge)
secureanadvantagescenechallenge.trigger: When you assess a situation, make preparations, or attempt to gain leverage within a scene challenge...

text.p: When you assess a situation, make preparations, or attempt to gain leverage within a scene challenge, envision your action and roll. If you act...

list.li: With speed, mobility, or agility: Roll +edge
With resolve, command, or sociability: Roll +heart
With strength, endurance, aggression: Roll +iron
With deception, stealth, or trickery: Roll +shadow
With expertise, focus, or observation: Roll +wits

text.p: On a hit, you are successful. On a strong hit, take both. On a strong hit with a match, take both and mark progress. On a weak hit, choose one.

list.li: Take +2 momentum
Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)

text.p: On a miss, you fail or your assumptions betray you. Fill a clock segment and Pay the Price. On a miss with a match, fill two segments and Pay the Price.

secureanadvantagescenechallenge.strong:
On a **strong hit**, you are successful. Take +2 momentum and add +1 on your next move (not a progress move).
On a **strong hit with a match**, take both and mark progress.
secureanadvantagescenechallenge.weak: On a **weak hit**, you are successful. Choose one. - Take +2 momentum - Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)
secureanadvantagescenechallenge.miss: On a **miss**, you fail or your assumptions betray you. Fill a clock segment and Pay the Price. On a **miss with a match**, fill two segments and Pay the Price.

beginasession.name: Begin a Session
beginasession.trigger: When you begin a significant session or chapter of play...

text.p: When you begin a significant session or chapter of play, do all of the following.

list.li: Identify or adjust flagged content and Set a Flag.
Review or recap what happened last session.
Set the scene by envisioning your character’s current situation and intent.

text.p: In addition, you may spotlight a new danger, opportunity, or insight. This can include a scene hidden from your character’s perspective. If you do, envision a brief vignette (you may roll or choose on the table below for inspiration). Then, all players take +1 momentum as you return to play from the viewpoint of your characters.

changeyourfate.name: Change Your Fate
changeyourfate.trigger: When you encounter flagged content, reject an oracle, resist a consequence, or otherwise need to shift your circumstances within the game for your comfort or enjoyment...

text.p: When you encounter flagged content, reject an oracle, resist a consequence, or otherwise need to shift your circumstances within the game for your comfort or enjoyment, pause and identify what needs to be changed. Choose as many options as appropriate.

list.li: Reframe: This didn’t happen the way you first thought. Envision the moment from another perspective in a way that diminishes or changes the content.
Refocus: This is not the most important thing happening right now. Envision how the spotlight shifts to change the focus.
Replace: This happens but with a small adjustment. Switch out an element and envision how this new detail changes the scenario.
Redirect: Adjust the trajectory to involve a helping hand. Envision how another person or party becomes involved.
Reshape: The situation changes completely. Envision what happened instead.

endasession.name: End a Session
endasession.trigger: When you end a significant session or chapter of play...

text.p: When you end a significant session or chapter of play, reflect on the events of the game and identify any missed opportunities to mark progress.

list.li: If you strengthened your ties to a connection, Develop Your Relationship.
If you moved forward on a quest, Reach a Milestone.

text.p: If there is a quest, connection, or other situation you would like to give focus in your next session, make note of it and take +1 momentum.

setaflag.name: Set a Flag
setaflag.trigger: When you identify situations or topics you don’t want to include, don’t want to envision in detail, or otherwise may need mindfulness when approaching...

text.p: When you identify situations or topics you don’t want to include, don’t want to envision in detail, or otherwise may need mindfulness when approaching, that content is now flagged.

When you encounter content flagged as something to approach mindfully, pause to consider or discuss its role in your story. When you come across flagged content that you would rather adjust or omit, Change Your Fate.

takeabreak.name: Take a Break
takeabreak.trigger: When you resolve a progress move or complete an intense scenario...

text.p: When you resolve a progress move or complete an intense scenario, take a few deep breaths and take some time to attend to the needs of your body. Reflect on what just happened and how it made you feel. Then, choose one.

list.li: Move on: Continue the session. You or an ally may add +1 on the next move (not a progress move), bolstered by your reflection and past experiences.
Stop for now: End a Session.

companiontakesahit.name: Companion Takes a Hit
companiontakesahit.trigger: When your companion faces physical hardship...

text.p: When your companion faces physical hardship, they suffer -1 health for minor harm, -2 for serious harm, or -3 for major harm. If your companion's health is 0, Lose Momentum equal to any remaining harm.
Then, if their health is 0 or you choose to test their resilience, roll +your companion's health.
On a strong hit, your companion rallies. Give them +1 health.
On a weak hit, if your companion's health is not 0, you may Lose Momentum (-1) and give them +1 health. Otherwise, they press on.

On a miss, it's worse than you thought. They suffer an additional -1 health or you Lose Momentum (-2). If your companion's health is 0, they are out of action until given aid. If their health is 0 and you rolled a miss with a match on this move, they are dead or destroyed; discard the asset.

companiontakesahit.strong: On a **strong hit**, your companion rallies. Give them +1 health.
companiontakesahit.weak: On a **weak hit**, if your companion's health is not 0, you may Lose Momentum (-1) and give them +1 health. Otherwise, they press on.
companiontakesahit.miss:
On a **miss**, it's worse than you thought. They suffer an additional -1 health or you Lose Momentum (-2). If your companion's health is 0, they are out of action until given aid.
If their health is 0 and you rolled a miss with a match on this move, they are dead or destroyed; discard the asset.

endureharm.name: Endure Harm
endureharm.trigger: When you face physical injury, fatigue, or illness...

text.p: When you face physical injury, fatigue, or illness, suffer -1 health for minor harm, -2 for serious harm, or -3 for major harm. If your health is 0, Lose Momentum equal to any remaining harm.
Then, if your health is 0 or you choose to resist the harm, roll +health or +iron, whichever is higher.
On a strong hit, choose one.

list.li: Shake it off: If you are not wounded, take +1 health
Embrace the pain: Take +1 momentum

text.p: On a weak hit, if you are not wounded, you may Lose Momentum (-1) in exchange for +1 health. Otherwise, press on.
On a miss, it’s worse than you thought. Suffer an additional -1 health or Lose Momentum (-2). If your health is 0, you must also mark wounded or permanently harmed, or roll on the table below.

endureharm.strong: On a **strong hit**, choose one. - Shake it off: If you are not wounded, take +1 health - Embrace the pain: Take +1 momentum
endureharm.weak: On a **weak hit**, if you are not wounded, you may Lose Momentum (-1) in exchange for +1 health. Otherwise, press on.
endureharm.miss: On a **miss**, it’s worse than you thought. Suffer an additional -1 health or Lose Momentum (-2). If your health is 0, you must also mark wounded or permanently harmed, or roll on the table below.

endurestress.name: Endure Stress
endurestress.trigger: When you face mental strain, shock, or despair...

text.p: When you face mental strain, shock, or despair, suffer -1 spirit for minor stress, -2 for serious stress, or -3 for major stress. If your spirit is 0, Lose Momentum equal to any remaining stress.
Then, if your spirit is 0 or you choose to resist the stress, roll +spirit or +heart, whichever is higher.
On a strong hit, choose one.

list.li: Shake it off: If you are not shaken, take +1 spirit
Embrace the darkness: Take +1 momentum

text.p: On a weak hit, if you are not shaken, you may Lose Momentum (-1) in exchange for +1 spirit. Otherwise, press on.
On a miss, it's worse than you thought. Suffer an additional -1 spirit or Lose Momentum (-2). If your spirit is 0, you must also mark shaken or traumatized, or roll on the table below.

factionnametemplate.name: Faction Name Template
factionnametemplate.description:
To generate a faction name, first roll or choose the name template. Then, follow the structure of the template to build the name from individual tables. If you’ve already set the faction type, picking from the tables (instead of rolling) will likely provide a more appropriate result. For example, “Silver Jackals” is a fitting name for a criminal organization. The “Empire of the Undying Suns” is a less apt name for that gang—unless their leader is prone to delusions of grandeur. In short, choosing a name will give you more control. Rolling might give you a result that doesn’t square with known aspects, but those contradictions may prove inspiring.
An alternative approach to generating a faction from scratch is to start with a random name. Then, consider what the name evokes and choose an appropriate faction type instead of rolling on those tables. For example, “Bloody Ravens” might suggest a mercenary guild, while the “Republic of the Radiant Servants” brings to mind a dominion built upon a religion, or one that idolizes a prophesied leader. If a result doesn’t inspire anything interesting, roll again or pick.

text.p: This work is based on Ironsworn, Ironsworn: Delve and Ironsworn: Starforged, created by Shawn Tomkin, and licensed for our use under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

The moves, assets, oracles and Delve's themes and domains come from Datasworn (https://github.com/rsek/datasworn and its community continuation, datasworn-community/official-content), whose schema and code are MIT-licensed; only the parts of its data licensed CC BY 4.0 are included.

This is an unofficial adaptation made for Kraken VTT, compatible with Ironsworn and Ironsworn: Starforged. It is not an official Tomkin Press product, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Shawn Tomkin or Tomkin Press. It uses no Tomkin Press art, icons or trade dress. The full rulebooks (free to download from the publisher) explain the games in far more depth.

The rules chapters in this book are Kraken VTT's own short explanation of how to play, written for this adaptation. The moves, assets and oracle tables are Shawn Tomkin's text (CC BY 4.0), lightly reformatted; changes made: links between moves shown as plain names, embedded tables kept as separate oracle tables.
Starforged's sample foes and setting truths are included as Datasworn gives them, CC BY 4.0.

You play a spacefarer in the Forge, a vast and lawless galaxy settled by people who fled a dying home. The game is about promises: you swear to do something hard, and the story is how you keep (or break) that promise.

You can play alone, with one friend as a pair, or as a group, with or without a game master. Whenever you do something risky the rules give it a move: a trigger ("when you...") and what happens on each result. Whenever you wonder what the world holds, you ask an oracle: a table that gives you an answer to interpret.
In Kraken, the GM's seat can play a character too: open Characters and make one like any player.
When a move asks you to roll +a stat, roll an action die (a d6) and add the stat and any adds the move or an asset gives. Your total is the action score; it can never be more than 10.
At the same time roll two challenge dice (d10s). Compare your score with each of them:

list.li: Beat both: a strong hit. You do what you set out to do.
Beat one: a weak hit. You do it, at a cost or with a complication.
Beat neither: a miss. Things go wrong; often you must Pay the Price.

text.p: A tie is not a beat: the challenge die wins. If the two challenge dice show the same number, it is a match: something surprising happens, good on a hit, worse on a miss.

The five stats are Edge (speed and precision), Heart (courage and charm), Iron (strength and endurance), Shadow (stealth and deceit) and Wits (insight and knowledge). Some moves roll a meter (health, spirit, supply) instead of a stat.
Momentum runs from -6 to +10 and starts at +2. Good results give you momentum; setbacks take it away.

Burning momentum. After a roll, if your momentum is higher than one or both challenge dice, you may burn it: your momentum becomes your action score (so a 7 beats a 6 and a 3), then it resets. You cannot burn momentum on a progress roll.
The reset is +2, but only +1 if you have one impact marked and 0 with more. Each impact also lowers your maximum momentum by one.
Negative momentum works against you: if your action die shows the same number as your negative momentum (a 3 at -3), the die counts as zero.
When you must lose momentum and it is already at -6, you make the Lose Momentum move's other choices.
A progress track has ten boxes, each filled by four ticks. Vows, journeys, expeditions, scene challenges, connections and fights are all progress tracks.
Each track has a rank, and the rank says how much one mark of progress fills:

To swear a vow, write what you swear to do and its rank, then make the Swear an Iron Vow move. As you overcome obstacles, Reach a Milestone and mark progress. When you believe the vow is done, Fulfill Your Vow: a progress roll. A progress roll uses no action die: your progress score (the number of filled boxes) is compared with the challenge dice, and momentum does not count.
You start with a background vow (epic): the long purpose behind everything you do.

Starforged has three legacy tracks: Quests (vows fulfilled), Bonds (connections become bonds) and Discoveries (expeditions finished and wonders found). Rewards are marked on them by rank: troublesome 1 tick, dangerous 2 ticks, formidable 1 box, extreme 2 boxes, epic 3 boxes.
Every box filled on a legacy track earns 2 experience. When a track's tenth box fills, it is cleared and starts again, and from then on each box earns 1 experience.
Connections are the people you know: each has a role and a rank, and its own progress track. When the relationship is ready, Forge a Bond.
Advance: spend 3 experience for a new asset or 2 to mark an asset's next ability. Kraken works out your experience from the legacy tracks and shows it on the sheet.

Health (your body), spirit (your morale) and supply (food, gear, fuel, money) each run from 0 to 5 and start at 5. Supply is shared: you and your allies keep one supply between you (Kraken keeps every party member's the same).

When you are hurt, Endure Harm: lose 1 health for minor harm, 2 for serious, 3 for major (a foe inflicts harm by its rank). When you are frightened or disheartened, Endure Stress and lose spirit. If a meter is already 0, what is left comes off momentum.
Ironsworn has no money, and neither does Starforged's sheet: what you can buy or barter is part of supply.

Impacts are lasting troubles: misfortunes (wounded, shaken, unprepared), lasting effects (permanently harmed, traumatized), burdens (doomed, tormented, indebted) and vehicle troubles (battered, cursed: on your starship). Each one marked lowers your maximum momentum by one and your reset (to +1 with one, 0 with more). Wounded stops health recovering, shaken spirit, unprepared supply, until they are cleared.
A fight starts with Enter the Fray: give each foe (or each objective) a rank and roll to see who has the upper hand. You either have in control or are in a bad spot.

In control, you Strike or Gain Ground; in a bad spot, you Clash or React Under Fire. Hits mark progress on the fight's track (Strike marks it twice). Foes hurt you by their rank: a troublesome foe 1 harm, up to 5 for an epic one.
When the track has enough progress, Take Decisive Action: a progress roll against the foe's track (in a bad spot, a strong hit without a match counts as a weak hit, and a weak hit as a miss).
In Kraken the GM puts foes on the combat tracker: each shows its rank and its ten-box track; your sheet's combat moves mark progress on the foe you target, and the tracker shows who is in control.

The oracles answer questions. Ask the Oracle for a yes or no: pick the odds (almost certain, likely, 50/50, unlikely, small chance) and roll a d100; under the number is yes. Or roll on a table (action and theme, descriptor and focus, a planet, a settlement, a derelict...) and interpret the result in the moment.
Trust your first instinct, and let the answer surprise you. When no one plays a game master, the oracles and the moves together run the world: the players ask, roll, and agree what it means.
In Kraken, open Oracles in the sidebar: every table of the book is there, rolled on the host's dice for the whole table to see; ask the oracle with one click.
Kraken's wizard follows these steps:

list.li: 1. Stats: 3, 2, 2, 1 and 1, one to each.
2. Paths: two path assets: who you are and what you can do.
3. Backstory and background vow (epic): what drives you.
4. Your starship: everyone has the Starship asset (a command vehicle); name it.
5. A final asset of any kind (not a deed: those are earned).
6. Your first connection: a name, a role and a rank.
7. The inciting incident: a vow that starts the story, of any rank.
8. Name, pronouns, callsign and look.

text.p: You start with health, spirit and supply at 5 and momentum at +2.

The sheet. Click a stat to see the moves it is used for; open Moves to make any move: choose its option (the stat it rolls), add any adds, and Roll. The host rolls the action die and the challenge dice for everyone to see, and posts the outcome with the move's text.

After the roll. What the outcome clearly does happens by itself (momentum taken, control won or lost, progress marked on the target). Choices ("choose one") become buttons. When you could burn momentum to do better, the sheet offers Burn momentum before anything is resolved.
Progress. The Vows tab keeps every progress track: mark progress by rank, roll against it, and fulfil it (the reward is marked for you).
Oracles roll in the Oracles window; the GM's foes go on the combat tracker.
When you act in direct support of an ally, envision how you aid them. Then, Secure an Advantage or Gain Ground to take action. If you score a hit, they (instead of you) take the benefits of the move.
If you Gain Ground and score a strong hit, you are both in control. On a weak hit, your ally is in control but you are in a bad spot.
When you check to see if you have a specific helpful item or resource, roll +supply.
On a strong hit, you have it, and are ready to act. Take +1 momentum.
On a weak hit, you have it, but must choose one.

list.li: Your supply is diminished: Sacrifice Resources (-1)
It's not quite right, and causes a complication or delay: Lose Momentum (-2)

text.p: On a miss, you don't have it and the situation grows more perilous. Pay the Price.
When you try to persuade someone or make them an offer, envision your approach. If you...

list.li: Charm, pacify, encourage, or barter: Roll +heart
Threaten or incite: Roll +iron
Lie or swindle: Roll +shadow

text.p: On a strong hit, they'll do what you want or agree to your conditions. Take +1 momentum.
On a weak hit, as above, but their agreement comes with a demand or complication. Envision their counteroffer.
On a miss, they refuse or make a demand that costs you greatly. Pay the Price.
When you attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat, envision your action and roll. If you act...

list.li: With speed, mobility, or agility: Roll +edge
With resolve, command, or sociability: Roll +heart
With strength, endurance, or aggression: Roll +iron
With deception, stealth, or trickery: Roll +shadow
With expertise, focus, or observation: Roll +wits

text.p: On a strong hit, you are successful. Take +1 momentum.
On a weak hit, you succeed, but not without a cost. Make a suffer move (-1).
On a miss, you fail, or a momentary success is undermined by a dire turn of events. Pay the Price.
When you search for clues, conduct an investigation, analyze evidence, or do research, roll +wits.
On a strong hit, you discover something helpful and specific. The path you must follow or action you must take to make progress is made clear. Envision what you learn. Then, take +2 momentum.
On a weak hit, the information provides new insight, but also complicates your quest. Envision what you discover. Then, take +1 momentum.
On a miss, your investigation unearths a dire threat or reveals an unwelcome truth that undermines your quest. Pay the Price.
When you assess a situation, make preparations, or attempt to gain leverage, envision your action and roll. If you act...

list.li: With speed, mobility, or agility: Roll +edge
With resolve, command, or sociability: Roll +heart
With strength, endurance, aggression: Roll +iron
With deception, stealth, or trickery: Roll +shadow
With expertise, focus, or observation: Roll +wits

text.p: On a hit, you succeed. On a strong hit, take both. On a weak hit, choose one.

list.li: Take +2 momentum
Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)

text.p: On a miss, you fail or your assumptions betray you. Pay the Price.
When you fight a battle and it happens in a blur, envision your objective and roll. If you primarily...

list.li: Fight at range, or using your speed and the environment to your advantage: Roll +edge.
Fight depending on your courage, leadership, or companions: Roll +heart.
Fight in close to overpower your foe: Roll +iron.
Fight using trickery to befuddle your foe: Roll +shadow.
Fight using careful tactics to outsmart your foe: Roll +wits.

text.p: On a strong hit, you achieve your objective unconditionally. You and any allies who joined the battle may take +2 momentum.
On a weak hit, you achieve your objective, but not without cost. Pay the Price.
On a miss, you are defeated or the objective is lost. Pay the Price.
When you are in a bad spot and fight back against a foe at close quarters, roll +iron; when you exchange fire at a distance, roll +edge.
On a strong hit, mark progress twice. You overwhelm your foe and are in control.
On a weak hit, mark progress, but you are dealt a counterblow or setback. You stay in a bad spot and must Pay the Price.
On a miss, your foe dominates this exchange. You stay in a bad spot and must Pay the Price.
When you initiate combat or are forced into a fight, envision your objective and give it a rank. If the combat includes discrete challenges or phases, set an objective with a rank for each.
Then, roll to see if you are in control. If you are...

list.li: On the move: Roll +edge
Facing off against your foe: Roll +heart
In the thick of it at close quarters: Roll +iron
Preparing to act against an unaware foe: Roll +shadow
Caught in a trap or sizing up the situation: Roll +wits

text.p: On a strong hit, take both. On a weak hit, choose one.

list.li: Take +2 momentum
You are in control

text.p: On a miss, the fight begins with you in a bad spot.
When you abandon or are deprived of an objective, envision the consequence of this failure, clear the objective, and Pay the Price.
If the fight continues, you may create a new objective and give it a rank to represent the changing situation. If any objectives remain, the fight continues and you are in a bad spot.
When you are in control and take action in a fight to reinforce your position or move toward an objective, envision your approach and roll. If you are...

list.li: In pursuit, fleeing, or maneuvering: Roll +edge
Charging boldly into action, coming to the aid of others, negotiating, or commanding: Roll +heart
Gaining leverage with force, powering through, or making a threat: Roll +iron
Hiding, preparing an ambush, or misdirecting: Roll +shadow
Coordinating a plan, studying a situation, or cleverly gaining leverage: Roll +wits

text.p: On a hit, you stay in control. On a strong hit, choose two. On a weak hit, choose one.

list.li: Mark progress
Take +2 momentum
Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)

text.p: On a miss, your foe gains the upper hand, the fight moves to a new location, or you encounter a new peril. You are in a bad spot and must Pay the Price.
When you are in a bad spot and take action in a fight to avoid danger or overcome an obstacle, envision your approach and roll. If you are...

list.li: In pursuit, fleeing, dodging, getting back into position, or taking cover: Roll +edge
Remaining stalwart against fear or temptation: Roll +heart
Blocking or diverting with force, or taking the hit: Roll +iron
Moving into hiding or creating a distraction: Roll +shadow
Changing the plan, finding a way out, or cleverly bypassing an obstacle: Roll +wits

text.p: On a strong hit, you succeed and are in control. Take +1 momentum.
On a weak hit, you avoid the worst of the danger or overcome the obstacle, but not without a cost. Make a suffer move (-1). You stay in a bad spot.
On a miss, the situation worsens. You stay in a bad spot and must Pay the Price.
When you are in control and assault a foe at close quarters, roll +iron; when you attack at a distance, roll +edge.
On a strong hit, mark progress twice. You dominate your foe and stay in control.
On a weak hit, mark progress twice, but you expose yourself to danger. You are in a bad spot.
On a miss, the fight turns against you. You are in a bad spot and must Pay the Price.
When you seize an objective in a fight, envision how you take decisive action. Then, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress.
If you are in control, check the result as normal. If you are in a bad spot, count a strong hit without a match as a weak hit, and a weak hit as a miss.
On a strong hit, you prevail. Take +1 momentum. If any objectives remain and the fight continues, you are in control.
On a weak hit, you achieve your objective, but not without cost. Roll on the table below or choose one. If the fight continues, you are in a bad spot.
On a miss, you are defeated or your objective is lost. Pay the Price.
When you reinforce your relationship with a connection by doing any of the following...

list.li: swearing a vow to undertake a perilous quest in their service
completing a quest to their benefit
leveraging their help in desperate circumstances
giving them something of worth
sharing a profound moment
standing with them against hardship
overcoming a test of your relationship

text.p: ...you may mark progress per the rank of the connection.

If you already share a bond with the connection, do not mark progress. Instead, roll +their rank to learn the impact on your legacy: troublesome=+1; dangerous=+2; formidable=+3; extreme=+4; epic=+5. On a strong hit, mark 2 ticks on your bonds legacy track. On a strong hit with a match, you may also envision how recent events bolstered your connection’s standing and raise their rank by one (if not already epic). On a weak hit, take +2 momentum. On a miss, take no lasting benefit.
When your relationship with a connection is ready to evolve, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress.

On a strong hit, you now share a bond. Mark a reward on your bonds legacy track per the connection's rank: troublesome=1 tick; dangerous=2 ticks; formidable=1 box; extreme=2 boxes; epic=3 boxes. Any allies who share this connection also mark the reward. Then, choose one.

list.li: Bolster their influence: When they aid you on a move closely associated with their role, add +2 instead of +1.
Expand their influence: Give them a second role. When they aid you on a move closely associated with either role, add +1 and take +1 momentum on a hit.

text.p: On a weak hit, as above, but they ask something more of you first. To gain the bond and the legacy reward, envision the nature of the request, and do it (or Swear an Iron Vow to see it done).

On a miss, they reveal a motivation or background that puts you at odds. If you recommit to this relationship, roll both challenge dice, take the lowest value, and clear that number of progress boxes. Then, raise the connection's rank by one (if not already epic).
When you search out a new relationship or give focus to an existing relationship (not an ally or companion), roll +heart.
On a strong hit, you create a connection. Give them a role and rank. Whenever your connection aids you on a move closely associated with their role, add +1 and take +1 momentum on a hit.
On a weak hit, as above, but this connection comes with a complication or cost. Envision what they reveal or demand.
On a miss, you don't make a connection and the situation worsens. Pay the Price.
When your relationship with a connection is tested through conflict, betrayal, or circumstance, roll +heart. If you share a bond, add +1.
On a strong hit, Develop Your Relationship.
On a weak hit, Develop Your Relationship, but also envision a demand or complication as a fallout of this test.
On a miss, or if you have no interest in maintaining this relationship, choose one.

list.li: Lose the connection: Envision how this impacts you and Pay the Price.

Prove your loyalty: Envision what you offer or what they demand, and Swear an Iron Vow (formidable or greater) to see it done. Until you complete the quest, take no benefit for the connection. If you refuse or fail the quest, the connection is permanently undone.

text.p: When your exploration of a waypoint uncovers something dreadful, decide the number of aspects: one, two, or three. Roll that number of times or choose that number of aspects on the table below. Then, envision how the encounter begins.
For each result, when you first confront that aspect within the scope of the encounter, you and your allies may mark one tick on your discoveries legacy track.
When you divert from an expedition to examine a notable location, roll +wits.
On a strong hit, choose one. On a strong hit with a match, you may instead Make a Discovery.

list.li: Find an opportunity: Envision a favorable insight, situation, resource, or encounter. Then, take +2 momentum.
Gain progress: Mark progress on your expedition, per its rank.

text.p: On a weak hit, you uncover something interesting, but it is bound up in a peril or reveals an ominous aspect of this place. Envision what you encounter. Then, take +1 momentum.
On a miss, you encounter an immediate hardship or threat, and must Pay the Price. On a miss with a match, you may instead Confront Chaos.
When your expedition comes to an end, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress.

On a strong hit, you reach your destination or complete your survey. Mark a reward on your discoveries legacy track per expedition's rank: troublesome=1 tick; dangerous=2 ticks; formidable=1 box; extreme=2 boxes; epic=3 boxes. Any allies who shared this expedition also mark the reward.
On a weak hit, as above, but you face an unforeseen complication at the end of your expedition. Make the legacy reward one rank lower, and envision what you encounter.
On a miss, your destination is lost to you, or you come to understand the true nature or cost of the expedition. Envision what happens and choose one.

list.li: Abandon the expedition: Envision the cost of this setback and Pay the Price.
Return to the expedition: Roll both challenge dice, take the lowest value, and clear that number of progress boxes. Then, raise the expedition's rank by one (if not already epic).

text.p: When your exploration of a waypoint uncovers something wondrous, roll on the table below or choose one. Then, envision the nature of the discovery and how it is revealed. When you first experience or engage with the discovery, you and your allies may mark two ticks on your discoveries legacy track.
When you follow a known route through perilous space, across hazardous terrain, or within a mysterious site, roll +supply.
On a strong hit, you reach your destination and the situation there favors you. Take +1 momentum.
On a weak hit, you arrive, but face a cost or complication. Choose one.

list.li: Suffer costs en route: Make a suffer move (-2), or two suffer moves (-1).
Face a complication at the destination: Envision what you encounter.

text.p: On a miss, you are waylaid by a significant threat, and must Pay the Price. If you overcome this obstacle, you may push on safely to your destination.

When you trailblaze a route through perilous space, journey over hazardous terrain, or survey a mysterious site, give the expedition a name and rank. Then, for each segment of the expedition, envision your approach. If you...

list.li: Move at speed: Roll +edge
Keep under the radar: Roll +shadow
Stay vigilant: Roll +wits

text.p: On a strong hit, you reach a waypoint. Envision the location and mark progress per the rank of the expedition.
On a weak hit, as above, but this progress costs you. Choose one.

list.li: Suffer costs en route: Make a suffer move (-2), or two suffer moves (-1).
Face a peril at the waypoint: Envision what you encounter.

text.p: On a miss, you are waylaid by a crisis, or arrive at a waypoint to confront an immediate hardship or threat. Do not mark progress, and Pay the Price.
When you seek to resolve questions, reveal details, discover locations, determine how other characters respond, or trigger encounters or events, you may...

list.li: Draw a conclusion: Decide the answer based on the most interesting and obvious result.
Spark an idea: Use an oracle table or other random prompt.
Ask a yes/no question: Decide the odds of a yes, and roll on the table below to check the answer.
Pick two: Envision two options. Rate one as likely, and roll on the table below to see if it is true. If not, it is the other.

text.p: Odds | The answer is yes if you roll... ---------------|--------------------------------- Small Chance | 10 or less Unlikely | 25 or less 50/50 | 50 or less Likely | 75 or less Almost Certain | 90 or less
On a match, envision an extreme result or twist.
When you suffer the outcome of an action, choose one.

list.li: Make the most obvious negative outcome happen.
Ask the Oracle for inspiration. Interpret the answer as a hardship or complication appropriate to the situation.
Roll on the table below. If the result doesn’t fit the situation, roll again.

text.p: When you develop your abilities, improve your resources, gain a reward, or boost your influence, you may spend 3 experience to add a new asset, or 2 experience to upgrade an asset. Choose from the following categories as appropriate to your focus and opportunities.

list.li: Module: Upgrade your command vehicle
Support Vehicle: Acquire or improve a secondary vehicle
Path: Bolster your personal capabilities or follow a new calling
Companion: Gain or improve a trusted helper
Deed: Learn from your experiences or build a legacy

text.p: When you retire from your life as Ironsworn, or succumb to death or desolation, you may create a new character in your established setting. If you do, roll the challenge dice and compare to each of the former character's legacy tracks: quests, bonds, and discoveries (one roll per track).
For each strong hit, choose one from below, or one from the weak hit or miss options.

list.li: Follow their path: Take one path or companion asset from the former character (at no cost), including any marked abilities.
Share a connection: Take one connection from the former character, including any accrued progress or bond benefits.
Accept an inheritance: Take the former character's command vehicle and one module or support vehicle (at no cost), including any marked abilities.

text.p: For each weak hit, choose one from below, or one from the miss options.

list.li: See it through: Choose one of the former character's unfinished quests, and Swear an Iron Vow (with an automatic strong hit) to see it done. You may immediately mark up to half their earned progress (round down) on this quest.

Rebuild a connection: Name one of the former character's connections, and envision how time or circumstances have changed them in a dramatic way. When you Make a Connection with them, take an automatic strong hit and mark two ticks on your bonds legacy track.

Explore familiar ground: Name a location that was meaningful to the former character. When you first visit that place, envision how it has changed or is endangered. Then, mark two ticks on your discoveries legacy track.

text.p: For each miss, choose one.

list.li: Deal with the aftermath: Envision how one of your former character's foes has gained power or influence.
Switch loyalties: Envision how you begin in opposition to your former character's beliefs, goals, or allegiances.
Open Pandora's Box: Envision how an advancement or discovery has unleashed unexpectedly dire consequences.

text.p: When you fill a box (four ticks) on any legacy track, take 2 experience. This experience may be spent when you Advance.

Once you completely fill the tenth box on any legacy track, clear that track. You may start again marking progress on the cleared track, but earn experience at a reduced rate of 1 experience (instead of 2) for each filled progress box. If you make a progress roll against this track, resolve the outcome as if at 10 progress.
When you renounce your quest, betray your promise, or the goal is lost to you, clear the vow.
Then, envision the impact of this failure and choose one or more as appropriate to the nature of the vow. Any allies who shared this vow may also envision a cost.

list.li: You are demoralized or dispirited: Endure Stress.
A connection loses faith: Test Your Relationship when you next interact.
You must abandon a path or resource: Discard an asset.
Someone else pays a price: Envision how a person, being, or community bears the cost of the failure.
Someone else takes advantage: Envision how an enemy gains power.
Your reputation suffers: Envision how this failure marks you.

text.p: When you reach the end of your quest, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress.

On a strong hit, your vow is fulfilled. Mark a reward on your quests legacy track per the vow's rank: troublesome=1 tick; dangerous=2 ticks; formidable=1 box; extreme=2 boxes; epic=3 boxes. Any allies who shared this vow also mark the reward.

On a weak hit, as above, but there is more to be done or you realize the truth of your quest. If you Swear an Iron Vow to set things right, take your full legacy reward. Otherwise, make the legacy reward one rank lower (none for a troublesome quest).
On a miss, your vow is undone through an unexpected complication or realization. Envision what happens and choose one.

list.li: Give up on the quest: Forsake Your Vow.
Recommit to the quest: Roll both challenge dice, take the lowest value, and clear that number of progress boxes. Then, raise the vow's rank by one (if not already epic).
